title: cornus fragifera
intro: Cornus fragifera, commonly known as the European dogwood or scarlet dogwood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cornaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cornus fragifera include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit cardiotonic and diuretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
